## P1–P4 self-check (required)

Which criterion does this advance? Check all that apply and explain in one line each:

- [ ] **P1 Real** — the task/artifact actually changes: …
- [ ] **P2 Verifiable** — the user can verify it: …
- [ ] **P3 Attributable** — the user can tell which step did it: …
- [ ] **P4 Perceivable** — recognizable in the UI: …

> ⚠️ Presentation-only proposals (visual polish, more effects) are presumed **non-substantive** per the project's core finding ([docs/EVIDENCE.md](../../docs/EVIDENCE.md)). If none of P1–P3 applies, please justify why this is still worth doing.

## Honesty check

- Does this introduce any new completion signal? If yes, what real event backs it?
- Does any fallback path need a `local`/`offline` label?
- Does it touch interruption semantics? (Interrupted must stay a third state.)
